bib.title: Unified Vision-Language Pre-Training for Image Captioning and VQA

question: Can one shared Transformer, pre-trained on image-text pairs, be fine-tuned for both vision-language generation (captioning) and understanding (VQA)?
hypothesis: A unified encoder-decoder pre-trained with bidirectional and seq2seq masked prediction (differing only in the self-attention mask) will speed up fine-tuning and beat both no pre-training and language-only pre-training on both task types.
contributions: A unified encoder-decoder VLP model with one shared multi-layer Transformer for encoding and decoding
Pre-training on two objectives, bidirectional and seq2seq masked vision-language prediction, switched by the self-attention mask
State-of-the-art results on COCO Captions, Flickr30k Captions and VQA 2.0 with one architecture

method.summary: A BERT-base Transformer initialised from UniLM takes 100 Faster R-CNN region embeddings plus caption tokens. It is pre-trained on Conceptual Captions with masked word prediction, alternating per batch between a bidirectional mask and a seq2seq (left-to-right) mask with proportion lambda, then fine-tuned on captioning (seq2seq) or VQA (bidirectional, MLP classifier).
method.task: vision-language pre-training; image captioning and visual question answering

datasets.name: Conceptual Captions (CC)
datasets.size: around 3 million web-accessible images with captions
datasets.preprocessing: sentences trimmed or padded to 20 words, BERT tokenisation

datasets.name: COCO Captions
datasets.preprocessing: sentences trimmed or padded to 20 words

datasets.name: Flickr30k
datasets.preprocessing: sentences trimmed or padded to 20 words

datasets.name: VQA 2.0
datasets.size: 443.8k questions from 82.8k images train; 214.4k questions from 40.5k images val
datasets.split: official partition; test-standard via the evaluation server; for test results models were trained on train+val
datasets.preprocessing: answer vocabulary of the top 3129 answers (k = 3129, following Anderson et al. 2018)

models.name: Unified VLP
models.architecture: 12-layer Transformer, same as BERT-base, shared for encoder and decoder; input = region embeddings + word embeddings + [CLS],[SEP],[STOP]
models.init_from: UniLM (Dong et al. 2019) pre-trained on text only (unless specified)

other.region_features: Faster R-CNN, ResNeXt-101 FPN backbone, pre-trained on Visual Genome (1600 object classes + attributes); fc6 output as feature, fc7 fine-tuned; exactly 100 regions per image
other.region_embedding: r_i = W_r R_i + W_p[LayerNorm(W_c C_i) | LayerNorm(W_g G_i)], G has 5 values (box corners and relative area)
other.vqa_head: Linear+ReLU+Linear+Sigmoid on element-wise product of last hidden states of [CLS] and [SEP]

models.name: Init from BERT / From scratch / Init from UniLM (no VLP)

training.objective: masked language prediction as in BERT (15% of caption tokens; 80% [MASK], 10% random, 10% original), bidirectional or seq2seq self-attention mask, alternated per batch with proportions lambda and 1-lambda; no next-sentence/image-text matching and no masked region classification. Fine-tuning: seq2seq for captioning; cross-entropy against soft labels for VQA; SCST for CIDEr optimisation
training.optimizer: same as BERT (Devlin et al.), details not given
training.lr: Table 8: CC 1e-4(x8); COCO 3e-5(x8); VQA 2.0 2e-5(x2); Flickr30k 3e-5(x8); COCO w/o pre-training 3e-4(x8); COCO SCST 1e-6(x4)
training.batch_size: Table 8: CC 64(x8); COCO 64(x8); VQA 2.0 64(x2); Flickr30k 64(x8); COCO w/o pre-training 64(x8); COCO SCST 16(x4)
training.epochs: Table 8: CC 30; COCO 30; VQA 2.0 20; Flickr30k 30; COCO w/o pre-training 30; COCO SCST 30
training.hardware: 8x V100 for pre-training, COCO and Flickr30k; 2x V100 for VQA; 4x Titan Xp for SCST
training.compute: Table 8 time per epoch: CC 5hr; COCO 12min; VQA 2.0 32min; Flickr30k 3min; COCO SCST 3hr

other.lambda: 0.75 for CC pre-training (light search over {0.25, 0.5, 0.75}); 1 for captioning fine-tuning; 0 for VQA fine-tuning
other.x_notation: (x8) etc. in Table 8 is printed without explanation, likely a multiplier for number of GPUs

inference.decoding: greedy search on the validation set; beam search with beam size 5 on the test set; generation starts from a [MASK] token and ends on [STOP]
inference.samples: single model, single reported run; no seeds stated

metrics.name: VQA accuracy
metrics.definition: official measure, overall and for Yes/No, Number, Other

eval.protocol: single models; cross-entropy only in Table 2 for fairness; CIDEr optimisation via SCST in Table 3; no seeds or significance tests

availability.weights: pre-trained models stated to be available at the same URL

limits: Region labels from the off-the-shelf detector are a fixed dependency; the authors hypothesise noisy labels hurt masked region classification, not tested further.
Unified joint training gives 'slightly compromised' results versus task-specific pre-training; separate models are optimal if affordable.
No seeds, variance or significance tests; hyper-parameter search is described as light.
Authors list text-image grounding, visual dialogue and multi-task fine-tuning as future work.
Claimed VQA state of the art ignores unpublished LXMERT (72.5) and ViLBERT (70.9) rows in its own Table 2.
Detector-region-based inputs have since been superseded; VLP still needs a pre-trained Faster R-CNN.
